title: What does write() do?
question: A program adds a line to a file. Where do the bytes go? (In memory: ramfs.)
text: Call 2, [write(fd, "more\n", 5)](2): [ksys_write](2:ksys_write) The syscall: the fd turns into the open file; with O_APPEND, the position is the file's end. [generic_perform_write](2:generic_perform_write) The bytes go into the file's pages in the page cache: in ramfs, that is where the file is. [simple_write_end](2:simple_write_end) The file is 5 bytes longer: its inode's size grows.
